visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a gray knitted top, sits in a brightly lit modern living room. She speaks directly to the camera with varied hand gestures against a background of a white sofa and indoor plants. (2) Two circular overlays appear on either side of her head, showing her in a white shirt with different expressions—one looking thoughtful and the other confident. Graphic wings and a halo appear behind the confident version, while devil horns appear behind the other. (3) A digital 'To Do List' graphic appears over the scene, listing several tasks in Chinese. The woman claps her hands and points forward with an enthusiastic expression. (4) A fast-paced montage follows, showing her in a white shirt at a desk. She is writing in a notebook, using a black laptop, and holding a small green glass bottle. A cat jumps onto her lap briefly as she works. (5) She is seen in different settings—a wooden-themed cafe and a modern office space—holding the same green bottle and drinking from it. She displays a piece of paper with '99' and 'very good!' written on it, cheering and throwing papers into the air. (6) The final phase shows her standing in a kitchen-like setting with several green bottles stacked on a table. She holds a bottle towards the camera, smiling, while several text overlays and graphics about product benefits appear around her.
